diff_profile.detect_all_audit_note: set; forced the Phase 3.1.5 completeness-critic pass

phase3_findings.description: resolve-guard-counts-file.sh's glob fallback cannot match the guard's bare store name, so a run-key mismatch silently reports a false zero
the resolver header claims the glob fallback covers run-key drift 'without going silent' and calls the divergence behaviorally inert; both false for the bare-name direction
a zero-byte counts store is reported as a positively-known zero rather than unavailable; the guard only creates that file on a deny, so zero-length means a partial write

harden_guard fires its fail-closed stub arm on every consumer-repo review run, emitting a spurious ::warning:: and writing phantom scripts/ and lib/test/ files into the consumer checkout (issue-#502 class)
render-guard-visibility.sh's arm-name regex is an uncoupled mirror of the guard's REMEDIATION keys; one unknown arm blanks the entire counts panel
Surface denied command detail swallows a helper failure with '|| true' and no breadcrumb, unlike its sibling branch in devflow-review.yml
harden_guard comment names a displaced_paths output the step does not publish (the key is guard_paths)
the new harden_guard step was inserted mid-sentence, splitting the pre-existing harden_hooks comment across 118 lines
the guard step's three-outcome comment states a false cause for the FIRED=false arm; _run() continues with tmp=None when the telemetry dir is unwritable
'It runs unconditionally, so this is non-empty on every run' is a universal the code does not guarantee (implicit if: success(), and the last-resort arm exits before writing)
the settings: comment labels the hook command REPO-RELATIVE; it is an absolute path resolved at run time from the repo root
resolver header understates the sanitizing divergence (Python str.isalnum is Unicode-aware) and omits that an existing-but-empty file is also rejected
the newline-flattening neutralization limb is untested although it is a stated security boundary
a dead resolve-guard-counts-file.sh invocation, and an assertion name claiming an empty-stdout guarantee the test never checks
no assertion that the pretooluse-probe job is declared in matcher-probe.yml (AC7); the helper-invocation grep survives a renamed or settings-stripped job
the settings input's merge-vs-overwrite semantics are unmeasured; under overwrite the base-restored Stop hooks would silently stop applying on the review tier
the guard and denied-commands runner steps, and devflow-review.yml's three-arm summary-append selection, are presence-pinned only with no behavioral driver
undocumented ordering dependency between the new attacker-influenced summary text and build-experiment-records.py's unanchored DENIAL_SUMMARY_RE
the bash exit-0 stub literal pin counts a branch harden_guard never executes, while the python branch it does execute carries no source-level pin
two sibling #458/#460 pins keep generic titles that now under-describe their population after harden_guard added a second site
harden_guard's disposition= output has no consumer; it is currently write-only
